question:
The following line graph shows the production of wheat in five different states in the year 2020.

What is the average production of wheat in these five states in the year 2020?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/264032ffe1bab618542531a6c8c271af68dd6b0c27bdf2c49e2991c60b6d8a85.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

60 + 80 + 62 + 50 + 48 = 300 So the average is 300/50 = 60 tonnes.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
